page.notes: The printed quotation marks („) appear at the start of every line of the Strauchius quotation; they are recorded once at the opening of the quotation. A small asterisk-like mark stands in the left margin beside the line "emendatione temporum", but it is not a readable note and is not transcribed. The italic/roman boundaries in the quotation are approximate. "aureain" and "£11" are doubtful readings. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout, and I/J has been normalised (Josephum, Judaeorum).
